entities.summary: The North Rhine-Westphalia Academy for Sciences, Humanities and the Arts, shortly known as NRW is a learned society in Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia. With more than 280 members the academy is the biggest humanities project in Germany. It has been noted as "an important part of the scientific landscape" of Germany, through bringing together outstanding academic personalities under one roof.
